audit.whatIsWrong: Level chart reads "Skill" at every stage, but the page's own content whys[0] states Ahri wins the level 1 poke war, and packet.levelChart disagrees with the page entirely.
audit.why: Orb of Deception is 970 range on a flat 7s cooldown at every rank; Aurora's Q is 900 range on 9s at rank 1. Ahri outranges by 70 units and re-poses 2s sooner, with no answer from Aurora until W at level 2. Levels 2+ are correctly even at 50.8% winrate over 3169 games.
audit.corrected: Level 1 side moves to Ahri (4/10) with a matching why; every later row stays even.

audit.why: Spikes are keyed to real events: level 3 full kit, level 6 Between Worlds vs Spirit Rush (both 140/120/100), first-item Q-E-Q rotation, late repositioning. spikes[] has all 4 entries and phases[] all 7.

The decisive interaction is stated and it is the right one: Riot's own Charm text says it instantly stops movement abilities, so it catches Across the Veil mid-hop; Charm is a flat 12s at every rank, 975 range. Orb of Deception's return deals true damage, so MR is the wrong buy — already stated in dontsFull[1].d. Essence Theft heals off 9 minions and every takedown, so Grievous Wounds timing matters — already stated in whys[6]. Both missingInteractions entries are therefore already covered on the page.
sources: champ-data/_kits ahri (E flat 12s/975, Q trueDamage flag + text, P heal)
